_comment: Proposed internal defaults from plan sections 7. To be agreed with the organisation's security team; not an organisational policy.
_semgrep_note: Heuristic rules that cannot tell parameterised from concatenated SQL are capped so they flag for review without blocking on their own.

required_tools._note: A project cannot turn these off in config.env. To waive one, add a time-boxed entry {tool, reason, approved_by, expires} to .security/exceptions.json.

presets._note: Defaults a team gets by choosing SEC_PRESET. Any explicit SEC_* setting overrides the preset. Tool values: auto (run when it fits) | on | off. Git-history secret scanning is opt-in on starter and standard (SEC_GITLEAKS_HISTORY=on, SEC_HISTORY_COMMITS=N) and on for strict.

_overdue_note: A finding recorded in baseline.json stops being 'existing' once it is older than sla_days for its severity: if its severity is in block_overdue it blocks again. Baselines without dates (old format) are not aged until re-created with `warden baseline`.

license_policy._note: deny -> HIGH, review -> MEDIUM, unknown -> LOW, permissive licences are not reported. Matched case-insensitively against SPDX-style names. Legal decides the lists; this is a starting point.
